This question asks about the preceding passage as a whole. Suppose the writer's primary purpose had been to explain how a public nuisance led to a lasting change in a city. Would this essay accomplish that purpose?

options.A: No, because it spends most of its length on the debate inside Parliament rather than on what was actually built.
options.B: Yes, because it follows the smell of 1858 from the bridges to Parliament and then to the sewers Bazalgette designed, much of which London still uses.
options.C: Yes, because it shows how the discovery that cholera spreads through water persuaded Parliament to pay for Bazalgette's sewers.
options.D: No, because it points out that the sewers were designed around a mistaken belief about disease, so their benefits came about by accident.
